title: United States of Mind
tagline: A silly game to help people coalesce around their values and found self-soverign states
description: Ideally, the game will be used to create a political alignment profile that can help people find value-aligned groups to join. Whether they be political action groups, or labor-focused guilds, these groups can serve their members and begin to iterate over governance processes to arrive at a more perfect state.
how_its_made: I'm just not a great developer, so running a solo project was tough. I was working with react, for instance, for the first time (I have back-end experience, not front-end).
